definition: A curated collection of examples used specifically to measure a model's performance, kept separate from training data to ensure an unbiased assessment.
details: The design and composition of evaluation datasets significantly shapes what capabilities get measured (and therefore optimized for), making careful evaluation dataset construction an important methodological consideration in ML research.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. In plain words: A curated collection of examples used specifically to measure a model's performance, kept separate from training data to ensure an unbiased assessment. Here is how it actually plays out: The design and composition of evaluation datasets significantly shapes what capabilities get measured (and therefore optimized for), making careful evaluation dataset construction an important methodological consideration in ML research. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. That shared ruler is Evaluation Dataset.
